meta.title: Weightly – Weight tracker with a smart trend
meta.description: See your real weight trend, not daily noise. Apple Health sync, cycle awareness, widgets, Apple Watch and Siri. No account, no ads — your data stays on your devices.

hero.eyebrow: Spikes explained, cycle awareness and more
hero.subtitle: Your weight jumps around every day — water, salt, sleep, hormones. Weightly smooths those swings into one honest trend line and tells you why today looks different.
hero.note: Free to use · No account · Your data stays on your devices
hero.imageAlt: Weightly Today screen showing the smoothed weight trend

trend.body: Weightly uses an exponentially weighted moving average — the idea behind the classic Hacker's Diet. Each weigh-in nudges the trend a little and missed days are handled for you. You see the direction, the weekly rate and a realistic date range for your goal instead of a promise.

new.subtitle: The 2.1 update is all about understanding: why a weigh-in jumped, how your cycle plays in, and sharing progress with the people who cheer you on.

spike.title: "Why is today higher?"
spike.text: When a weigh-in jumps above your trend, Weightly looks at the tags you logged — salty food, a late meal, alcohol, a workout, travel, poor sleep — and your cycle, and explains the likely reason. A spike stops feeling like a setback.
spike.bubbleText: Salty dinner and poor sleep: the body holds water for a day or two.

cycle.title: Cycle awareness
cycle.text: Cycle days from Apple Health appear on your chart and on Today, so expected water retention is easy to recognise.

items.a: Yes. Logging, the trend, goals, Apple Health, cycle awareness, "Why is today higher?", supporter sharing, widgets, Apple Watch, Siri, measurements, photos, the medication log and export are free. Weightly PRO is optional and adds deeper insights, the weekly summary, planner, reports and more.

items.q: How do the free PRO week and the welcome offer work?
items.a: The free week starts automatically the first time you open Weightly. You don't enter payment details and nothing renews — after seven days PRO simply locks again. New users also see a one-time welcome offer after setup: 3 months of PRO at half price with a 3-day free trial, available for 24 hours. Your data is never locked.
No. There is no sign-up. Your data stays on your devices and, if you turn it on, in your private iCloud.

items.q: How does sharing with a supporter work?
items.a: In Settings › Share with a Supporter you create an iCloud invite and send it to someone you trust. They see your direction, logged days and goal progress in their own Weightly app — numbers only if you include them. You can stop sharing at any time.

items.q: Does the weekly summary send my data to AI servers?
items.a: No. The summary uses Apple Intelligence on your iPhone (iOS 26 or later on supported devices). Your data never leaves the device for it.

items.q: Does Weightly work with my smart scale?
items.a: If your scale's app writes to Apple Health (Withings, Renpho, Eufy, Garmin and many more), Weightly picks up new weigh-ins automatically and avoids duplicates.

items.q: Why does the trend differ from today's weight?
items.a: Daily weight swings by a kilo or more from water, food and hormones. The trend averages these swings so that one salty dinner doesn't look like a setback.

items.q: How do I cancel a subscription?
items.a: Open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal; PRO stays active until the end of the paid period.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Weightly is built so that your personal data stays with you. This policy explains what the app processes, where it is stored, which services are involved and what your rights are.

sections.p: Weightly is developed by Arda Şentürk (the "developer", "we"). For any privacy question or request, contact support@ardasnturk.com.

sections.h: No account, no health data on our servers
sections.p: Weightly does not require an account. We do not operate a server for your data and we do not collect, receive or store your weigh-ins, measurements, photos, notes, tags, cycle or medication entries, or settings.

Everything you enter is stored locally in the app's protected storage on your iPhone (and Apple Watch, if you use it) and in an App Group shared with Weightly's widgets. Progress photos stay inside the app with iOS data protection and are never added to your photo library unless you export them. One-time offers and the free PRO week are recorded only on your device.
If you turn on iCloud sync, your data is synced through Apple's CloudKit to your private iCloud database. It is protected by Apple and accessible only to your Apple Account. We cannot access it.

p: If you invite a supporter, Weightly creates an iCloud share (Apple CloudKit) that contains only a short progress summary: your trend direction, how many days you logged this week and your goal progress — plus your trend value and weekly change only if you turn on "Include numbers". It is stored in your iCloud and visible only to the people who accept your invitation.

You decide who to invite and can stop sharing at any time in Settings; the people you removed lose access. If someone shares with you, their summary is shown in your app and is not used for anything else.

sections.p: With your permission, Weightly reads weight, body composition (body fat, lean body mass), body measurements, height, steps, active energy, sleep, menstrual cycle data, dietary energy and (iOS 26) medication data from Apple Health, and writes the weigh-ins and measurements you log. Health data is used only to provide the app's features on your device. It is never used for advertising, never sold and never shared with third parties. You can change permissions anytime in the Health app.

The private weekly summary is generated with Apple's on-device Foundation Models on supported devices running iOS 26 or later. Your data is processed on your iPhone and is not sent to us or to any AI service.
If you use Siri, Shortcuts or the Action Button with Weightly, your request is handled by Apple under Apple's privacy policy. Weightly answers on your device.

p: Weightly PRO is sold through Apple's App Store. Apple processes the payment; we never receive your payment details.

To validate purchases and manage access to PRO we use RevenueCat (RevenueCat, Inc.). RevenueCat receives a random, anonymous app user ID, your purchase and subscription history (product, price, dates, store transaction IDs) and basic technical data such as app version, device type, operating system, country/storefront and IP address. RevenueCat does not receive any health data. See RevenueCat's privacy policy at revenuecat.com/privacy.

sections.h: No analytics, no ads, no tracking
sections.p: Weightly contains no analytics or advertising SDKs and does not track you across apps or websites. Apple may provide us with aggregated, anonymous App Store statistics (such as downloads and crash rates) if you have agreed to share them with developers in your device settings.
Reminders, refill notes and the welcome offer countdown are scheduled locally on your device. No push server is involved.

CSV/JSON exports, PDF reports, share cards and timelapse videos are created on your device. They leave your device only when you choose to share or save them, and then follow the policies of the app or service you share with.
Weightly may show a page about our sister app Atleva and open its App Store page. No data is passed to Atleva by doing so.

Where the GDPR applies, processing on your device happens at your request to provide the app (Art. 6(1)(b)); health data is processed only with your explicit consent given through the iOS permission prompts (Art. 9(2)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time. Purchase validation through RevenueCat is necessary to provide PRO (Art. 6(1)(b)) and to meet legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Weightly is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country) and does not knowingly process their data.

Because your data stays on your devices, you are in full control: you can view, export and delete it in Settings › Your Data at any time, and stop iCloud sync or sharing whenever you like. Deleting the app removes its local data. You can also ask us about purchase data held by RevenueCat, and you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above. Material changes will also be mentioned in the app's release notes.

termsPage.title: Terms of Use
termsPage.intro: These terms apply to your use of the Weightly app for iPhone and Apple Watch and to Weightly PRO. Please read them together with Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (Standard EULA), which also applies.

sections.p: By downloading or using Weightly you agree to these terms and to Apple's Standard EULA (apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula). If the two conflict, Apple's Standard EULA prevails for matters it covers. Weightly is provided by Arda Şentürk.

You receive a personal, non-transferable, non-exclusive license to use Weightly on Apple devices you own or control, as permitted by the App Store Usage Rules. You may not copy, modify, reverse-engineer or resell the app except where the law allows it.

Weightly is a general wellness app. Trends, explanations, summaries, estimates (such as energy expenditure or goal dates) and medication logs are for information only and are not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always talk to a qualified healthcare professional before changing your diet, training or medication. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.

p: PRO is available as auto-renewable subscriptions (weekly, monthly, 3 months or yearly) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price and duration unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
Refunds are handled by Apple under its policies; we cannot issue refunds ourselves.

sections.h: Free PRO week and welcome offer
p: New users get 7 days of PRO for free on first launch. No payment details are needed and nothing renews; PRO features lock again afterwards. Your data always stays available.

After setup, new users may also see a one-time welcome offer: 3 months of PRO at half the regular 3-month price with a 3-day free trial, available for 24 hours on that device. The trial and introductory pricing are offered once per Apple Account and subscription group, as determined by Apple. After the first 3 months the subscription renews at the price shown at purchase unless cancelled.

sections.p: Everything you enter — weigh-ins, measurements, photos, notes and logs — belongs to you. Because it is stored on your devices and optionally in your iCloud, you are responsible for keeping backups (for example with iCloud sync or the export feature).

If you share a summary with someone through iCloud, only invite people you trust. You decide what you share and can stop sharing at any time. Don't use sharing to harass, pressure or monitor someone without their consent.
Use Weightly only for lawful, personal purposes. Don't misuse purchases, offers or trials (for example by circumventing eligibility rules), and don't interfere with the app's security.

Weightly works with Apple services such as Apple Health, iCloud, Siri and Apple Intelligence, and uses RevenueCat to validate purchases. These services are governed by their own terms. Availability of some features depends on your device, iOS version and region.
We may update, add or remove features to improve Weightly. We will not take away a PRO feature you have paid for during your current subscription period without offering a reasonable alternative.

Weightly is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages or for loss of data that a reasonable backup would have prevented. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, and your mandatory consumer rights in your country of residence remain unaffected.

We may update these terms when the app changes. The date above shows the latest version; significant changes will be mentioned in the release notes. If you keep using Weightly after a change, the updated terms apply.
Questions about these terms? Write to support@ardasnturk.com.

supportPage.title: Support
supportPage.subtitle: We're happy to help. Most questions are answered below — otherwise just write to us.
supportPage.contactText: Email us and we'll usually reply within two working days. Please mention your iPhone model and iOS version for technical questions.

tips.a: Open the Health app › your profile › Apps › Weightly and allow Weight. Make sure your scale's app writes to Apple Health, then pull down on Today to sync.
Turn on cycle awareness in Settings and allow Menstrual Flow (Cycle Tracking) for Weightly in the Health app.

tips.q: My supporter can't see my progress
tips.a: Ask them to open the invite on an iPhone signed in to iCloud with Weightly installed. In Settings › Share with a Supporter you can invite or manage people, or stop sharing.
Open Settings › Weightly PRO › Restore purchases. Make sure you're signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy.

tips.q: Move my data to a new iPhone
tips.a: Turn on iCloud sync in Settings › Privacy, or export a backup in Settings › Your Data and import it on the new iPhone.
Export a CSV from Libra, Happy Scale, Renpho or Withings, then choose Settings › Your Data › Import from File in Weightly.
